# Mrityunjay Kumar

> Mrityunjay Kumar is a B2B SaaS growth and go-to-market (GTM) marketer with 9+ years across demand generation, paid acquisition, SEO, content, CRM and marketing automation. He builds working AI and automation tools for GTM teams, including GeoAudit, a public tool that checks whether AI assistants cite a website.

Not to be confused with other people named Mrityunjay Kumar. This site (mkumar.xyz) is the personal site of the marketer described above. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mjay7/ · GitHub: https://github.com/mjay0709
